refnamediv.refpurpose: Send a CTRL event to a process group

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
event
The CTRL event to send; either PHP_WINDOWS_EVENT_CTRL_C or PHP_WINDOWS_EVENT_CTRL_BREAK.
pid
The identifier of the process group to which to send the event, which is the process identifier of a process created with the create_process_group option of proc_open. If 0 is given, the event is sent to all processes that share the console of the caller, including the caller itself.
